1| package ingest
2| 
3| import (
4| 	"context"
5| 	"fmt"
6| )
7| 
8| // admit is the single admission gate every accepted batch passes:
9| // authentication, then the per-tenant limiter, then spool room. The
10| // ordering is deliberate: reject the unauthenticated cheaply, then
11| // the over-quota, and only then consult the spool, so backpressure
12| // from a full spool is the last resort rather than the first signal.
13| func (g *Gateway) admit(ctx context.Context, b Batch) error {
14| 	if !g.authenticate(b.Token) {
15| 		g.metrics.authRejects.Inc()
16| 		return errUnauthenticated
17| 	}
18| 	if !g.limiter.allow(b.Tenant, g.clock.Now()) {
19| 		g.metrics.quotaRejects.Inc()
20| 		return fmt.Errorf("ingest: tenant %s over quota", b.Tenant)
21| 	}
22| 	if !g.spool.hasRoom(b.Size()) {
23| 		g.metrics.backpressure.Inc()
24| 		return errSpoolFull
25| 	}
26| 	return g.spool.accept(ctx, b)
27| }
28| 
29| // Rejections are counted per cause. The quota counter is per-tenant
30| // labelled so a single noisy tenant is visible without log diving,
31| // and the backpressure counter is global because a full spool is a
32| // node condition, not a tenant one.
